meta.name: budgeting-and-forecasting
meta.description: Runs the planning cycle — annual budget, rolling forecast, consolidation of business unit inputs, and the variance analysis that explains actuals against plan. Use this to build or challenge a budget, run a forecast cycle, consolidate departmental submissions, explain why results diverged from plan, or improve forecast accuracy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制定年度预算与滚动预测,并分析实际与计划的差异
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要编制年度预算或滚动预测,并想解释实际与计划的偏差。
copy.tagline_en: Build annual budgets and rolling forecasts, and analyze variances against plan.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create annual budgets or rolling forecasts and explain deviations from plan.

howto.what: Claude 会执行预算与预测流程:设统一假设、按模板收集部门输入、质疑数据、合并找差距并削减具体项目、公布未资助项;还做滚动预测和差异分析,将差异拆为数量、费率、时机、组合。
howto.when: 当你说要制定或挑战预算、运行预测周期,或解释实际与计划的差异时触发。

say.text: 帮我制定年度预算,先定好假设框架。
say.note: Claude 会先设目标、人员上限等共同假设。

say.text: 把各部门的预算合并,找出差距并削减。
say.note: 会找出上下级差距,并砍掉具体项目。

say.text: 解释这个季度实际与预算的差异,只讲最大的几项。
say.note: 按数量、费率、时机、组合来拆解。

howto.what_en: Executes the planning cycle: sets assumptions, collects template-based inputs, challenges them, consolidates, cuts named items to close gaps, and publishes unfunded items. Runs rolling forecasts and variance analysis broken into volume/rate/timing/mix.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to build or challenge a budget, run a forecast cycle, or explain variances from plan.

say_en.text: Help me build the annual budget, starting with the assumption framework.
say_en.note: It will set targets, headcount envelope, etc.

say_en.text: Consolidate departmental budgets and close the gap.
say_en.note: Finds top-down/bottom-up gap and cuts named items.

say_en.text: Explain this quarter's variance versus budget; focus on top items.
say_en.note: Breaks down by volume, rate, timing, and mix.
